packet.title: Canonical EXI
packet.summary: The encoder's canonical form: event choice, the ordering of attributes and namespace declarations, whitespace, canonical values, utcTime and omitOptionsDocument.

item.p: Owns: the canonical part of src/exi_encoder.c and src/exi_datatype.c.
Done when: every encode check of the canonical sets passes byte for byte and is in the ratchet; omitOptionsDocument is tested by a unit test.
